description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesList' that displays a list of notes with search, pagination, and delete functionalities. It manages state, effects, and user interactions related to notes.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: Type defining the props for the NotesList component, including an onError callback.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch notes from the API based on current search parameters and update state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a note by ID, with user confirmation and error handling.
